answer: Each identity's 20,000 POA bond is carved in marble before its first vote, and the ledger scores identity pairs every round. When two identities match on nine of the last ten votes, the younger is flagged and burns 3,000 POA, fifteen percent of its bond; a third flag hauls the whole remainder to the jetty to burn. A mesa of clones running in sync therefore loses 3,000 POA per fake identity per flagged round and up to 20,000 by the third, while honest nodes that rarely agree alike pay nothing.
